_vars.bg: on completely flat solid warm cream background color #F5EFE3, no texture no gradient pure single flat color background
_vars.style: bold watercolor wash over rough exploratory pencil sketch underdrawing, pencil lines remain visible and expressive beneath the wash, Persian blue for clothing and shadows, warm amber and brown skin tones, natural hair colors, confident dramatic brushwork, strong use of negative space
_vars.neg: photorealistic, 3d render, anime, cartoon, flat vector, clipart, text, logos, dark background, textured background, gradient background, watercolor paper texture, canvas texture, head-on symmetrical portrait, blue hair, purple hair

prompt: Strong side profile of a young woman in her late twenties, face in silhouette toward the left. She holds a small book up close to her face, reading, eyes moving across the line. Her features are sharp in the pencil underdrawing; the watercolor wash is bold across her cheek and hair. Empty warm cream to the right. Quiet absorbed intelligence.

An elderly hand, with visible veins and age spots, resting gently and still on the bowed head of a young child. Just the hand and the top of the child's head, hair visible, filling the lower portion of the frame. Nothing else. The gesture is benediction, or comfort. Pencil sketch for the hair strands; warm watercolor wash for the skin.

Two people seen from directly behind, sitting close together on a low stone step. An elderly woman on the left, a teenage boy on the right. Both look down at something between them that is out of frame. Her hand points at it. His head tilts. Simple flowers grow at the base of the step. Seen entirely from behind; no faces visible.

Extreme close-up: a single hand holding a pen, hovering just above an open journal page. The pen is mid-motion, having just finished a word. The cursive script on the page is rendered as loose pencil marks, not readable. Just the hand and the page, filling the frame. Left-handed. Warm amber skin. A moment of thought between words.

A single figure, a middle-aged man, seen from behind, standing alone at the edge of a very simple field. He is small in the frame, positioned at the lower left. He faces away from the viewer toward open space. Sparse grass strokes at his feet. Enormous warm cream above and to the right. The posture is still, looking outward.

Strong side profiles of two people facing each other in conversation: an elderly man on the left and a young woman on the right. Both in profile, the man speaks with a slight lean forward, the woman listens with her chin slightly lifted. A thin strip of empty space between their faces. Just the two profiles and the space between them.

Close-up of two hands mid-page-turn: one hand holds the book open, the other lifts a page, caught in the motion of turning. The page is translucent in the watercolor, half-lifted. Pencil lines for the paper edges. Just the hands and the open book in the lower center of the frame. A quiet act of attention.

Side profile of a young child, about 6, looking upward with wide open eyes, listening to something above and off-frame. The profile is sharp pencil sketch with blue watercolor wash over the clothing. The child's expression is one of rapt attention and wonder. Positioned at left; vast empty cream to the right.

One hand open, palm up, receiving. Another hand above it, gently placing something small into the palm. The object is not clearly defined, just a small warm shape. The two hands are the entire composition: one giving, one receiving. Different ages, different skin tones. Shot from above, filling the frame.

Over-the-shoulder view from behind and slightly above: a person seated, writing in an open journal. The viewer sees the back of the head, the shoulder, and the journal page below. The hand holds a pen. The writing on the page is loose pencil strokes. The person's natural hair and clothing in blue watercolor. Intimate and introspective.

Low angle, looking up at an elderly man seated on a bench, his hands resting on his knees, looking calmly into the middle distance above the viewer. His face is weathered and dignified. A simple tree branch crosses the upper corner in loose pencil lines. The angle gives him great presence and stillness. Warm amber skin, white hair.

An elderly hand and a young child's hand, both resting flat and side by side on the same open page of a book. The large wrinkled hand and the tiny smooth hand together on the cream page. That is the entire image: the two hands and the book beneath them. Size contrast. Pencil lines for the page; warm watercolor for the skin.

A young woman walking away along a narrow path through open prairie, seen from behind. She is small, in the lower center of the wide frame. The path is a thin pencil line receding into the distance. Sparse grass at the edges rendered in upward blue-green watercolor strokes. Vast open cream sky above. The figure walks at a comfortable unhurried pace.
